senses.gloss:
—1 A field under water; meadow; केदारेभ्यस्त्वपोऽगृह्णन्कर्षका दृढसेतुभिः
 Bhāg. 10. 20. 41; Ms. 9. 38, 44; cf. the play on words in the Subhāṣ.
 के दारपोषणरताः? and the reply is केदारपोषणरताः.
—2 A basin for water round the root of a tree.
—3 A mountain.
—4 A particular mountain forming part of the Himālayas (modern Kedār).
—5 A form of Śiva.
—6 N. of a Rāga (in music).
.━{@Comp.@}: केदारखण्डम्, केदारनाथः

केदारः + -खण्डम् a small dyke, earth raised to keep out water; गच्छ
 केदारखण्डं बधान Mb. 1. 3. 22.
केदारः + -नाथः a particular form of Śiva.
